verdict.rationale: A developer API platform could plausibly ship an in-product assistant, such as a dashboard copilot, so this axis applies. The evidence shows AI features only as API endpoints for developers to call: AI-generated Answers, summarization, and LLM Context. It also shows integrations with external agents (an MCP server, Claude, OpenClaw, Dify). Nothing documents a built-in assistant inside the product that a user can hand tasks to.
